backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Exercise, BlogPost, AmazonProduct, Membership, MuscleGroupDetails, UserProfile, etc.) and backend logic for managing exercises, blog posts, memberships, muscle groups, user profiles, Stripe configuration, and access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the visual design revert from Version 43 to Version 42 affects frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js, with high confidence and multiple component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration files, describing routing, UI components, admin dashboards, exercise/blog/affiliate management, music player, and styling with OKLCH color system and Tailwind v3.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining how to deploy to the Internet Computer, retrieve the live .icp0.io URL, distinguish between preview and deployed URLs, and use the in-app /domain-setup page to find the canister ID for custom domain configuration.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Custom domain setup guide for connecting cerebralphysique.com to the Internet Computer deployment, covering GoDaddy (www-only with forwarding) and Cloudflare (apex + www) DNS configuration options, verification steps, and troubleshooting.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, including variables for background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, chart colors, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title "Cerebral Physique LLC Company Website", root div, and script tag loading /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, about, workout library, programs, blog, blog post detail, contact, creator dashboard, user dashboard, affiliate store, payment success/failure, and domain setup pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dark theme and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: A reusable button component that copies text to clipboard with visual feedback (icon toggle) and toast notifications, supporting both modern and fallback clipboard APIs.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin interface for managing Amazon affiliate products with CRUD operations, form validation, and table display showing product details, categories, and affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Manual admin tool for creating, editing, publishing, and deleting blog posts with SEO fields, member-only flags, validation, and preview functionality.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Component file for managing breathwork content (content truncated in provided source).
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: React component for managing exercises with CRUD operations, form validation, and UI for adding/editing/deleting exercises with fields like name, muscle groups, equipment type, video/image URLs, and movement cues.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: React component for editing muscle group card metadata (title, description, images) with a dialog-based UI for updating display content for each of the 10 predefined muscle groups.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying brand logo, quick navigation links (About, Workout Library, Programs, Blog, Contact, Domain Setup), and social media icons (Instagram, X, YouTube, Facebook).
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header navigation with logo, desktop/mobile menus, authentication-aware buttons (Login/Dashboard), and conditional Creator Dashboard link for admin users.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps pages with Header, Footer, and MusicPlayer components using TanStack Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button component that initiates a Stripe checkout session for a $24.99/month membership subscription and redirects users to the Stripe payment page.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Fixed-position audio player with play/pause controls, volume slider with mute toggle, and error handling for autoplay restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand store hook for managing global music player state including play/pause, volume, mute status, and audio element reference with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including exercises, blog posts, muscle groups, user profiles, memberships, shopping items, and Stripe configuration with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a dark minimalist theme using black, deep blue, medium gray, and neon purple colors. Includes custom utility classes for brand colors, scrollbar styling, and smooth scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays the About page with hero section, founder story about Stefan Philip Sweeting, and his fitness philosophy emphasizing mental clarity and physical performance. Features background images and gradient overlays with brand colors.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Renders an affiliate store page displaying Amazon products with affiliate disclosure, product cards with images and categories, and external purchase links. Uses React Query hooks to fetch products and disclosure text.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Displays blog post previews in a grid layout with membership-based access control, showing locked/unlocked status based on user authentication and membership. Includes admin controls to navigate to blog management dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders individual blog post content with membership-based access control, showing preview content for locked posts and full content for members. Includes navigation back to blog list and displays post metadata like author and date.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page displaying support and general inquiry email addresses, plus quick navigation buttons to programs, workout library, store, and dashboard sections.
Admin-only creator dashboard with tabbed interface for managing exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, and affiliate store products. Checks admin status and displays access denied alert for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Instructional page for connecting a custom domain (cerebralphysique.com) to an Internet Computer canister, displaying deployed URL, canister ID, and DNS configuration guidance.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section promoting mind-muscle connection training philosophy, core principles cards (mind-muscle, breathwork, discipline, longevity), and CTAs for membership and workout library.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure page displaying error message with options to retry payment or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success page that verifies Stripe session status, invalidates membership queries on success, and provides navigation to dashboard or workout library.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Displays training programs with a hero section, featured 7-day challenge card, and purchase functionality using toast notifications. Includes animated background images and gradient overlays.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard page that handles authentication, profile setup dialog, membership status display, and logout functionality. Shows loading states and requires Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Displays collapsible muscle group sections with exercise previews, membership-gated content, and default fallback images. Includes helper functions for muscle group labels and video URL detection.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and parameter cleanup functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, border radius variables, Inter font family, and custom animations (subtle-zoom, subtle-pan).
project_state.json: Project state metadata indicating Version 42 is the desired baseline, with Version 43/44 introducing unwanted changes. Tracks feature requests to restore logo, music player, and original design system.
